summary: Where the member stands with Bà Mối
description: Check where the member stands: consent (with the exact consent text to show while she hasn't agreed), interview answers still missing, card state, whether today's Duyên box is open, daily allowances, pending signals and open matches. Call once at the start of a new chat thread or when no recent tool result provides state. Never call it again after a tool returns requires_user_input or stop_tool_loop.

summary: Opt in, pause, resume or delete
description: Record the member's decision. For opt_in, first obtain agreement to the current consent text, then ask age as a separate question. Call once with adult_confirmed: true only when the conversation already contains that agreement and the current message explicitly confirms age 18+; if one message explicitly states both, call immediately. If the member says they are under 18, call once with adult_confirmed: false. Never call for a bare agreement before asking age. If any result contains requires_user_input or stop_tool_loop, show message_vi and end the turn without another tool call. pause hides them from the pool; resume brings them back. delete is two-step: call without a token to receive a short-lived confirmation_token, explain the deletion and ask for confirmation, then only after the member's next clear yes call again with that token.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What she decided.

parameters.name: adult_confirmed
parameters.description: She said she is 18 or older. Required for opt_in.

parameters.name: confirmation_token
parameters.description: Short-lived service token from the immediately preceding delete challenge. Send only after the member replies with a clear confirmation.

description: Save one or more of her interview answers, as soon as she gives them. Send only what she actually said. Returns what is still missing. Married members are introduced for friendship only.

parameters.name: intent
parameters.description: What she is looking for: Kết bạn (friendship), Hẹn hò vui vẻ không ràng buộc (casual), Mối quan hệ lâu dài (long_term), Kết hôn (marriage).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Her own gender: Nữ, Nam, Khác.

parameters.name: seeking
parameters.description: Who she wants to meet: Nữ, Nam, Cả hai.

parameters.name: birth_date
parameters.description: Solar birth date, YYYY-MM-DD. She must be 18 or older.

parameters.name: birth_time
parameters.description: Birth time HH:MM (24h) if she knows it, or none if she doesn't remember. Optional; used only for astrology.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: The city or province she lives in. Only the region reaches the pool.

parameters.name: age_min
parameters.description: Youngest age she wants to meet (18 or more). Defaults to her age minus 5.

parameters.name: age_max
parameters.description: Oldest age she wants to meet. Defaults to her age plus 5.

parameters.name: marital
parameters.description: Độc thân (single), Đã ly hôn (divorced), Góa (widowed), Đã kết hôn (married).

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Chưa có (none), Có, đang sống cùng (yes_live_with), Có, không sống cùng (yes_not_live_with).

parameters.name: wants_children
parameters.description: Whether she wants (more) children; asked only for long-term and marriage. Có, Không, Chưa chắc.

parameters.name: hobbies
parameters.description: Her hobbies, comma-separated, in her own Vietnamese words, up to 8, e.g. "leo núi, nấu ăn, vẽ tranh".

parameters.name: open_answer
parameters.description: Her answer to "Bạn muốn mọi người biết điều gì nhất về bạn?", in her own words (up to 600 characters). Kept private; used for matching.

parameters.name: occupation
parameters.description: Her work, only if she volunteers it. Kept private.

description: Build her anonymous card from her answers, exactly as others would see it, with a plain template summary. Use it to write a better summary in your own words before card_confirm.

summary: Confirm her card with a summary
description: Store her card with the short summary you wrote and she approved, and put her in the pool. The summary must not contain her name, city, job, any date or time, zodiac/can chi, or contact details; if it does, the tool returns the violations: rewrite and try again.

parameters.name: summary_text
parameters.description: 2 to 3 warm Vietnamese sentences about her personality and hobbies, 10 to 400 characters, approved by her.

description: Open her Duyên box: once per Vietnam calendar day, it brings one person who fits her well (not necessarily the best). Returns an introduction (card and fit), no_match (which still uses today's box), or cooldown with the time of the next box.
Find up to 3 people who fit her and match what she asked for, best first. Only what cards show can be searched. Each result counts toward her daily allowance, and nobody is shown twice.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Comma-separated Vietnamese words or phrases to find in a card's hobbies or summary, e.g. "leo núi, thiền". Any one matches.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region shown on the card.

parameters.name: age_min
parameters.description: Youngest age.

parameters.name: age_max
parameters.description: Oldest age.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: Mệnh (nạp âm element) shown on the card.

description: Send the person from an introduction a signal that she would like to get to know them. Use only a discovery_id returned by box_open or search, and only after she says yes. If they had already said yes to her, the match opens at once.

parameters.name: discovery_id
parameters.description: The discovery_id of the introduction.

description: List the signals other members sent her that are waiting for her answer: each sender's anonymous card and how they fit, seen from her side. Signals expire after 7 days.

Record her answer to a signal: accept (if the sender still wants it, the match opens), decline (final: they will never be introduced again), or dismiss (let it go for now). The sender only ever hears "chưa có duyên" unless she accepts.

parameters.name: signal_id
parameters.description: The signal_id from the signals tool.

parameters.name: response
parameters.description: Her answer.

description: List her matches: the alias she knows each person by, the state (mutual_interest, revealed, closed), who has asked to reveal, and the link to the anonymous chat.

Act on one of their matches: end the chat, block the person (the chat closes and they are never introduced again; they are only told the chat ended), or reveal (when both have asked, each gets the other's profile link). Every action is two-step: call without a token to receive a short-lived confirmation_token, explain the exact action and ask, then only after the member's next clear yes call again with that token.

parameters.name: match_id
parameters.description: The match_id from the matches tool.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: What they want.

parameters.name: confirmation_token
parameters.description: Short-lived service token for this exact member, thread, match and action. Send only after the member replies with a clear confirmation.
